kernel_adaptation_genuineness.claim_matc.reason: The cyclic local kernel is implemented, but the stated full kernel differs from the executed construction. The paper multiplies both local and far-field components by the learned amplitude product. The implementation applies that modulation only to the local component and adds an unmodulated far-field term. These are different covariances when the amplitude coefficients change.
evidence: proposal/report.tex:289-302 defines sigma_s(x)=exp(a^T b(o)) and the full kernel as sigma_s(x)sigma_s(x') times (k_loc+k_far).
proposal/code/gpk/kernels.py:76-89 defines the far-field design solely from geographic bumps; lines 170-182 apply amplitude modulation to the local kernel.
proposal/code/gpk/model.py:53-57 fixes G independently of the amplitude parameters; lines 215-242 use that unmodulated G in the Woodbury solve and determinant.

proposal/code/run_taxi_full.py:97-99 selects this ExactGP implementation; proposal/logs/taxi_full_cyclic.log:2 identifies its 560,000-point cyclic run, and line 18 records accepted amplitude-block updates.

The paper describes natural-gradient SVGP parameters, adaptive MCMC proposals and posterior summaries from the second half of each chain. The code uses a Cholesky variational distribution with ordinary Adam, fixed proposal scales and means over the entire stored chain.

proposal/report.tex:404-409 describes natural-gradient variational parameters; proposal/code/run_svgp_baseline.py:89-96 uses CholeskyVariationalDistribution and lines 116-124 use plain Adam over all parameters.

proposal/code/gpk/model.py:349-354 averages every stored chain state; proposal/code/run_taxi_full.py:101-109 uses that mean for prediction.
